name: Love Bite
source: He lived by his own rules and principles. But the unpredictable fate took its toll. Remain true to yourself or omit all the rules and agree with your fate? Is this a difficult beginning of new life? Or maybe… its her end…
translation: 他按照自己的规则和原则生活。但不可预测的命运却让他付出了代价。忠于自己还是忽略所有规则并接受你的命运？这是新生活的艰难开始吗？又或许……这就是她的结局……
